score_definition: Average each frozen KIBA identity fold's predictions. For margin, retain ceil(N/4) candidates with highest target scores, then rank target_score minus avoid_score descending. Ties: target score descending, SHA256(parent key) ascending. No conversion to Kd or occupancy.
primary_endpoint: Family-macro operational joint-pass lower bound among all three recommendations; unknowns consume budget and contribute zero to this lower bound.
random_control: Exact expected endpoints for uniform sampling without replacement, budget three; no favorable random seed selection.
uncertainty: Paired family bootstrap conditional on fixed predictions and recommendations; supplementary crossed family/compound exponential-weight resampling. No independent-pair significance claims or retraining uncertainty.
dti_claim: No DTA superiority over DTI claim: matched classifier baseline not implemented. Thresholded regression scores are not presented as a fair DTI baseline.
interpretation: Operational assay-based selection, not validated negatives, complete kinome selectivity, cell probe qualification, or prospective confirmation. Keep all predefined tasks and all QC profiles regardless of outcome.
